sections.heading: About Kiran
sections.source: Kiran's resume (ResumeKiranS.pdf, Drive, Aug 2026). Laser, IPL, microneedling, piercing, chemical peels and status wording left out (NAE compliance rules). Other employers are not named. Kiran approves the wording.
body: Kiran has worked in esthetics since 2012, in spas and salons and as an educator training new and experienced estheticians.
Teaching is where Kiran shines: clear demonstrations, hands-on practice, and keeping track of every student's progress until they are ready to work on their own clients.

list: Lash extensions (classic, hybrid and volume) and lash lifts
Brow mapping, lamination, tinting and microblading
